description: Rich 2026-10-06: 'no, all buildings must connect'. Strict road-connected spatial transport: first player road sets the founding-supply anchor, every building joins the anchor's road network, finite carriers move all construction, recipe and household goods between local depots and the anchor. Apply after candidate_playable_slice_v1 and empty_settlement_start_v1. Provisional numbers, not balanced.

spatial.source: Provisional lean values (Claude, 2026-10-06): 6 carriers of 4 units at 2 m/s; a 40 m route is a 40 s round trip. Water/slope margins match the client's placement rules. Not tuned.
